body-sm.purpose: SM: buttons, fields, menus and dense rows, 14/20.

label.purpose: Field labels and button text, medium weight.

code.purpose: Inline and block code, mono stack.

shadows.name: surface-light
shadows.purpose: Cards and resting surfaces, light appearance (theme.SurfaceShadows); the edge lit from above sits along the bottom inside edge.

shadows.name: surface-dark
shadows.purpose: Cards and resting surfaces, dark appearance; the edge sits along the top inside edge.

shadows.name: field-light
shadows.purpose: Outline buttons, light appearance (theme.FieldShadows); fields at rest carry only the drop layer.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, pickers and dialogs (theme.OverlayShadows); the edge, lit from above, is black 4% along the bottom inside edge in light and white 6% along the top inside edge in dark.

shadows.name: solid-button
shadows.purpose: Primary and destructive buttons; removed while pressed.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Motion.State: a control changing state in place (fill, border, ink, a mark drawing in, content swapping with a spinner, a calendar view swapping).

motion.name: thumb-press
motion.purpose: Effects.ThumbPressScale: a held slider, colour-area or switch thumb grows.

motion.name: collapse
motion.purpose: A sidebar or resizable panel collapsing.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Motion.Reveal: content opening or a mark sliding; a layout pane folding (ease-out); the effect Reveal.

motion.name: indicator
motion.purpose: An indicator sliding to another item (tabs, segmented control, tour dots).

motion.name: roll
motion.value: 300ms; ease-out (NumberFlip digits), ease-in-out (Tour travel), linear (Tour crossfade)
motion.purpose: Motion.Roll: a changing number turning its digits.

motion.name: shift
motion.purpose: Motion.Shift: rows and tabs moving aside for a dragged one.

motion.name: page
motion.purpose: Motion.Page: carousel and navigation stack page slide.

motion.name: popup
motion.purpose: Motion.Popup: anchored popups fade from Effects.PopupScale (0.98); floating panel.

motion.name: dialog
motion.purpose: Motion.Dialog on Motion.EaseTravel: dialogs, sheets, Modal and ImageViewer, with their scrim.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Motion.Drawer on Motion.EaseDrawer: drawers, bottom and floating sheets, with their scrim.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Motion.Ease.

motion.name: ease-travel
motion.purpose: Motion.EaseTravel.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Progress and meter value changes (component constant).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: PressableFeedback scales custom pressable surfaces to 98.5%.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Toast deck position and size (toast constants).

motion.name: loading
motion.purpose: Content and loading indicator crossfade.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Effects.SpinnerPeriod.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: Effects.SweepPeriod and SweepBand: one sweep shared by a progress bar and a region refresh line; the band enters wholly before the track and leaves wholly past it.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Effects.ShimmerPeriod, ShimmerPeak, ShimmerPeakDark: skeletons and the effect Shimmer; pulse lowers a skeleton to half alpha and back, the same alone and in SkeletonGroup.

motion.name: status-dot
motion.purpose: StatusDot ambient motion.

breakpoints.name: layout-compact
breakpoints.purpose: layout panes leave the row and show as a flush sheet; the gallery shell uses this layout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a surface; solid ink with a soft drop and inner highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 10px; border: 0; background: oklch(26.9% 0 0); color: oklch(98.5% 0 0); font: 500 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(26.9% 0 0 / 24%), inset 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 16%); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(26.9% 0 0 / 90%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70.8% 0 0); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; popover face, translucent border and the field shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); background: #fff; color: oklch(26.9% 0 0); font: 500 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%), inset 0 -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 6%); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 2%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70.8% 0 0); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and inline actions; transparent until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 10px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(26.9% 0 0); font: 500 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 4%); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70.8% 0 0); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line field; the border turns to Ring with a 3px translucent ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); background: #fff; color: oklch(26.9% 0 0); font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(70.8% 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(70.8% 0 0 / 24%); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: oklch(63.7% 0.237 25.331 / 36%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Grouped content on the surface fill with a hairline border and the surface shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 8%); background: #fff; color: oklch(26.9% 0 0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%), inset 0 -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 4%); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-desc { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: oklch(50% 0 0); }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Short hint on the popover fill, MD radius, tooltip shadow over a hairline.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; max-width: 320px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 8%); background: #fff; color: oklch(26.9% 0 0); font: 400 12px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Soft status badge: the status fill at 8% with its foreground.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 18px; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(69.6% 0.17 162.48 / 8%); color: oklch(50.8% 0.118 165.612); font: 500 12px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Compact neutral surfaces, clear text hierarchy and restrained state feedback for native MyGo desktop applications. This file is the authority for how mygoui looks and moves. A rule that is missing is added here through an OpenSpec change. It was extracted from the implementation; it does not establish a new identity.

Values are written so a reader needs nothing else. They are executed in Go: colours, type, spacing, radii, sizes, shadows, motion and effect tokens in `theme/` (one `theme.Theme` value, `theme.Default()` being this record), and component geometry in each component's file. When Go and this record differ, this record wins: the mismatch is a defect, and a change settles it by correcting the code, or the record if the record was wrong.

One `px` in the frontmatter is one unscaled native DIP, not a physical pixel. Text scaling (`theme.Scale`) and host preferences still apply. `docs/design.md` owns engineering contracts, `docs/components.md` owns the supported subset of each component, and `docs/references.md` records where these rules came from and the licensing boundary.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ink on white or near-black; colour is reserved for state and data.
Hairline translucent borders and very soft shadows instead of heavy chrome.
Desktop density: 32 DIP controls, 14 DIP control text, a 4 DIP rhythm.
Short, ease-out state motion; nothing moves at rest.

rules.name: The State Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue appears for state and data only: destructive, info, success, warning and chart series. Navigation, selection and emphasis use ink and neutral fills, unless a host sets an accent for Primary.

rules.name: The Translucent Line Rule
rules.body: Borders, inputs and accent fills stay translucent so they read the same on every surface they sit on. Host overrides are set per appearance.

rules.name: The Steady Weight Rule
rules.body: A state never changes font weight. Selected, active, hover and current text keeps its weight, because heavier text is wider and shifts the layout. A state shows in fill, ink, an indicator or an icon.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Default controls are 32 DIP tall with 14 DIP text. Larger sizes exist for emphasis, not for touch.

rules.name: The Still Overlay Rule
rules.body: Under reduced motion every overlay, popup, dialog, sheet, drawer, floating panel and scrim appears and disappears at once, fades included.

rules.name: The Quiet List Rule
rules.body: Menus, selects and combo boxes open, close and move their highlight at once: a list the user is scanning never animates.

rules.name: The Hairline Edge Rule
rules.body: Every floating surface carries a 1 DIP edge with its shadow, so it stays legible when the shadow is invisible on a dark or busy backdrop.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Under `theme.ReduceMotion(c)` control state motion keeps its fades while sizes, positions, scales and loops settle at once. Overlays keep nothing: see the Still Overlay Rule.

rules.name: The One Loading State Rule
rules.body: A component shows waiting one way for its kind (table above); it never stacks a spinner, a skeleton and a scrim.

dos: Do read roles through `theme.Colors(c)` and sizes through `theme/`; keep this record and the Go values in step in the same change.
Do reuse theme roles and coherent public components before extracting more.
Do keep borders, inputs and accent fills translucent, and composite them on the real surface.
Do pair every floating surface's shadow with its 1 DIP edge.
Do show a state in fill, ink, an indicator or an icon, with the motion above.
Do inspect light and dark, compact and wide, and stateful native output.
Do keep UI copy concise and reveal secondary help only when needed.
Do add a missing rule to this file through a change instead of borrowing one from another system.
donts: Don't change font weight with state.
Don't animate menus, list highlights, typing, drags or anything at rest.
Don't substitute CSS colour mixing or rounded hex values for derived colours.
Don't replace native editing or focus with pointer-only drawings.
Don't invent fonts, palettes, mobile targets or new product claims.
Don't treat HTML/CSS detector output as evidence about Go controls.
Don't claim GPU, OS gesture or screen-reader success from headless images.
